verdicts.decision_note: The client confirms the connectors and 3V3/5V rail flow from the power board through the main board to the sensor board.
The client explicitly defines the board-chain order and the main board's behavior of consuming and forwarding incoming power; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
The client states that the design now uses only one board and identifies the three interboard-cabled boards as the previous architecture, eliminating the board-chain power-distribution behavior.
